task: A caller holds an accepted multi-wave plan and wants the next wave run now, with each lane's result reported back rather than a judgment on the whole plan.
query: execute the next wave of this plan and report per-lane evidence
rationale: Implement now owns executing caller-authorized work, including a supplied wave and its per-lane checks. A finished-change validation request is different; rpi requires explicit traversal selection, while agent-native owns runtime packet dispatch rather than the implementation outcome.
notes: Owner migrated from the retired crank wrapper. This remains an execution request over supplied work, with per-lane evidence; it does not authorize a scheduler or a new aggregate controller.
